A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Live Avatar research work, with 33 complete pages including appendices A–H. Pages 2–33 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance. First-page differences concern authorship, affiliation, version/date information and layout.

before.justification: v4 reports original GenBench experiments, efficiency and component ablations, and appendix results covering AV-Speech, 10,000-second generation and a 20-participant user study.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experimental and user-study results, including the main-text evaluations and supplementary Tables 7–11.

M1.justification: The two-stage training pipeline, History Corrupt, Adaptive Attention Sink, Rolling RoPE and Timestep-forcing Pipeline Parallelism are unchanged. Section 4 and appendix Algorithms 1–4 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same AVSpeech training and evaluation data, GenBench short- and long-video coverage, 10,000-second stress scenario and user-study population. No dataset, task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 2, 8 and 9: Ditto, EchoMimic-V2, Hallo3, StableAvatar, OmniAvatar and WanS2V. EchoMimic-V2 remains excluded from the long-video comparison.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1–5.3 and appendices C–E retain identical splits, sample sizes, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, hardware settings and testing procedures.

E4.justification: The efficiency, stability-component, denoising-step, cache-noise and motion-scaffolding analyses are unchanged. The appendices retain the same extrapolation test, user study, block-size ablation and FP8 comparison.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including the participant-averaged, normalized user ratings in Table 9. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval or significance reporting is added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings are unchanged across the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains 45.2 FPS and GenBench-LongVideo IQA of 4.76 for Live Avatar; supplementary results also match exactly.

T1.justification: The flow-matching and DMD formulations, autoregressive factorization and modeling assumptions are identical. No mathematical definition, derivation, theorem or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about real-time 14B streaming, long-horizon stability, training convergence and GenBench.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations of benchmark and user-study results are identical. The limitations concerning the static-scene prior and approximately three-second end-to-end interaction latency remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, kernel optimizations and pseudocode are identical. The project-page link and promised camera-ready release of GenBench and evaluation scripts are unchanged.

R1.justification: Related-work discussion, research positioning and all 58 references are identical. The added author does not accompany any change in citations or novelty claims.

P1.justification: v5 adds Weiqiang Wang to the author list and Monash University as affiliation 5, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Research prose, terminology and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author and affiliation block reflows the first page and shifts Figure 1 and its caption slightly downward. Figure content is unchanged, and pages 2–33 retain identical figures, tables and layout.

improvement.justification: v5 changes authorship information and first-page formatting while retaining the complete scientific content, experimental evidence, reproducibility information and limitations. These limited editorial changes produce no meaningful difference in the paper's overall research quality.
